newsitem.title: USA: Clinton backs Daschle abortion compromise.
newsitem.headline: Clinton backs Daschle abortion compromise.

text.p: The White House Wednesday said President Clinton had decided to support Senate Democratic Leader Tom Daschle's compromise efforts to limit late-term abortions.
Clinton "indicated to Senator Daschle this morning that he would be supportive of Senator Daschle's amendment" to restrict so-called partial-birth abortions, spokesman Mike McCurry said.

McCurry said that "the president has long been an opponent of late-term abortions" but was concerned about a measure sponsored by Sen. Rick Santorum, a Pennsylvania Republican, that would allow the procedure only when a woman's life was at risk.
Daschle has drafted a compromise that would include bans on all late-term abortions with exceptions for cases where the woman's life was in danger or where she risked "grievous injury" to her health.
The White House spokesman said that Clinton also could support a similar amendment by Sen. Dianne Feinstein, a California Democrat.

The procedure, which opponents call partial birth abortion, involves the partial extraction of the foetus and the subsesquent suctioning out of the foetal brain. The Senate currently is debating the legislation.
